This folder should contain the end-user distribution installers for Dynamic Web TWAIN Service.

Place the following files here (obtain from Dynamsoft):
- DynamicWebTWAINServiceSetup.msi
- DynamicWebTWAINServiceSetup.pkg
- DynamicWebTWAINServiceSetup.rpm
- DynamicWebTWAINServiceSetup.deb
- DynamicWebTWAINServiceSetup-arm64.deb

If you put the `DynamicWebTWAINServiceSetup.msi` file here, it will be served at:
/assets/Resources/dist/DynamicWebTWAINServiceSetup.msi

Note: These installers are not included in the repository for licensing reasons. Download them from your Dynamsoft account or contact your vendor.
